changes.purpose: Give the reference scheduler's Complete operation an assignment token derived at lease time from job, owner, and lease epoch, reject mismatched completions even when the owner matches, and add an independent stale-completion checker over transition history.
task_groups: State machine change: token on Complete, BLAKE3 domain-separated derivation, typed StaleAssignmentToken rejection, positive/negative fixtures (owner-returns, wrong token, reuse, epoch overflow), update every Complete call site
Independent check: pure history-derived assignment-epoch checker, deliberately broken scheduler variant must fail the checker, retain owner-returns regression
Validation and closeout: focused reference-service and fabric-simulation tests, formatting, Clippy, Octet, Cairn validation, proposal/design/tasks gates, plus retained non-claims
required_gates: Octet checks and the existing strict Octet gate
primary_surfaces: crates/molten-core reference scheduler state machine and operations
simulation composition invariant evaluation inputs and tests
changes.risks: Owner-returns ABA trace must be rejected by token, not owner; every Complete call site must migrate or the migration is incomplete
changes.independence_note: Proposal states add-protocol-aware-simulation-oracles provides the independent-evaluation direction but this change stays implementable without it

Old-callback-after-eviction, duplicate issuance, logical-name reuse, and sequence-exhaustion tests with rejected-state equality
Deterministic retention and checked occurrence admission in the pure core without an unbounded retired-ID collection
Update checked capacity planning and shell reservations without hidden capacity growth
Preserve F09 blocked occurrence identity and F10 shared Ready admission during retention integration
Docs for schema/cohort compatibility, deterministic replay, evicted-history readback, receipt non-claims
Focused Octet checks, existing strict Octet gate, Clippy across required targets and features
Required workspace tests, relevant Nix checks, and the repository Nix gate without weakening existing checks
Native .cairn/ validation and required gates with tracked evidence
